assertions.description: RTCConfiguration.rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy is a real dictionary member: a connection constructed with "require" reports it from getConfiguration() (an ignored unknown member would be absent).
assertions.test: (() => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: 'require' }); const v = pc.getConfiguration().rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy; pc.close(); return v === 'require'; })()

assertions.description: With no policy given, getConfiguration().rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy is "negotiate" (the dictionary default).
assertions.test: (() => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection(); const v = pc.getConfiguration().rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy; pc.close(); return v === 'negotiate'; })()

assertions.description: An unknown RTCRtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy value is rejected by the RTCPeerConnection constructor (WebIDL enum conversion throws TypeError).
The "disable" enum value is accepted and reflected (it was added to the enum after the first implementation).
assertions.test: (() => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: 'disable' }); const v = pc.getConfiguration().rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy; pc.close(); return v === 'disable'; })()

assertions.description: Under the default "negotiate" policy, createOffer() includes the a=cryptex attribute (RFC 9335 capability signal).
assertions.test: (async () => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: 'negotiate' }); pc.addTransceiver('audio'); const o = await pc.createOffer(); pc.close(); return /^a=cryptex/m.test(o.sdp); })()

assertions.description: setConfiguration() with a different rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy throws InvalidModificationError.
assertions.test: (() => { const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: 'negotiate' }); if (pc.getConfiguration().rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy !== 'negotiate') { pc.close(); return false; } try { pc.setConfiguration({ ...pc.getConfiguration(), rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: 'require' }); pc.close(); return false; } catch (e) { pc.close(); return e.name === 'InvalidModificationError'; } })()

assertions.description: With "require", setRemoteDescription() of an offer that lacks a=cryptex rejects with InvalidAccessError.
assertions.test: (async () => { const a = new RTCPeerConnection({ rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: 'negotiate' }); const b = new RTCPeerConnection({ rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy: 'require' }); if (b.getConfiguration().rtpHeaderEncryptionPolicy !== 'require') { a.close(); b.close(); return false; } a.addTransceiver('audio'); const o = await a.createOffer(); const sdp = o.sdp.replace(/^a=cryptex\r?\n/gm, ''); try { await b.setRemoteDescription({ type: 'offer', sdp }); return false; } catch (e) { return e.name === 'InvalidAccessError'; } finally { a.close(); b.close(); } })()

assertions.description: Once both sides signal a=cryptex, RTP header extensions and CSRCs are encrypted in transmitted packets (RFC 9335 §5.1).
assertions.test: Packet contents are not observable from page script; verify with a packet capture (the 0xC0DE/0xC2DE extension profile) on a call negotiated in /v160/rtp-header-extension-encryption/loopback-negotiation/.
